scripts.start: npm run clean:start-cache && npm run build:rust:wasm && npm run build:core && npm run build:rust:web && npm run build --prefix projects/ui-grid-vanilla && npm run build --prefix projects/ui-grid-react && (trap 'kill 0' INT TERM; npm run watch --prefix projects/ui-grid-vanilla & ng serve)
scripts.start:vanilla: npm run build:rust:wasm && npm run build:core && npm run build:rust:web && npm run start --prefix projects/ui-grid-vanilla
scripts.build: npm run build:rust:wasm && npm run build:core && npm run build:rust:web && npm run build --prefix projects/ui-grid-vanilla && npm run build --prefix projects/ui-grid-react && ng build
scripts.build:pages: npm run build:rust:wasm && npm run build:core && npm run build:rust:web && npm run build --prefix projects/ui-grid-vanilla && npm run build --prefix projects/ui-grid-react && ng build --configuration production --base-href /uiGrid/ --deploy-url /uiGrid/
scripts.build:library: npm run build:rust:wasm && npm run build:core && npm run build --prefix projects/ui-grid-vanilla && ng build uiGridPackage
scripts.build:package: npm run build:library:preset -- --preset=full && node scripts/prepare-release-package.mjs --presets full
scripts.build:vanilla: npm run build:rust:wasm && npm run build:core && npm run build:rust:web && npm run build --prefix projects/ui-grid-vanilla
scripts.test: npm run build:rust:wasm && npm run build:core && ng test --watch=false && npm test --prefix projects/ui-grid-core && npm test --prefix projects/ui-grid-react && npm test --prefix projects/ui-grid-vanilla
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:rust:wasm && npm run build:core && ng test --watch=false && npm run test:coverage --prefix projects/ui-grid-core && npm run test:coverage --prefix projects/ui-grid-react && npm run test:coverage --prefix projects/ui-grid-vanilla
scripts.test:angular: npm run build:rust:wasm && npm run build:core && npm run build:rust:web && npm run build --prefix projects/ui-grid-react && ng test --watch=false
scripts.build:react: npm run build:rust:wasm && npm run build:core && npm run build:rust:web && npm run build --prefix projects/ui-grid-vanilla && npm run build --prefix projects/ui-grid-react
scripts.test:react: npm run build:rust:wasm && npm run build:core && npm run build:rust:web && npm run build --prefix projects/ui-grid-vanilla && npm test --prefix projects/ui-grid-react
scripts.test:vanilla: npm run build:rust:wasm && npm run build:core && npm run build:rust:web && npm run build --prefix projects/ui-grid-vanilla && npm test --prefix projects/ui-grid-vanilla
